name: Alderney
facts: Self-governing part of the Bailiwick of Guernsey
King Charles III, as Duke of Normandy

flag.description: A white field with the red cross of St George, with a green disc edged in gold at the centre showing a gold lion holding a sprig of leaves.
flag.symbolism: The St George's cross reflects the island's loyalty to the English Crown, and the lion on its green disc comes from Alderney's old island seal.

hook: Alderney is England's cross with a green coin at the crossing, a gold lion inside it waving a sprig of leaves.
trivia: The green disc with the lion and gold scrollwork is taken from a seal used by the island since the 18th century.
Alderney is the northernmost inhabited Channel Island, about 15 km off the coast of Normandy.
